opis: The cosy bedroom at night from the reference picture (the same striped blue wallpaper, the window with the moon, the bed, the round blue rug), the big light switched off. The little bedside lamp is turned towards the wall and throws a big warm circle of light on it; in the circle a big dark SHADOW of a FOX HEAD made of flat paper shapes: one big triangle pointing down for the face and two small triangles for the pointed ears. The BEAR, in front of the wall, holds up the paper fox made of a red triangle and two purple triangles on a stick; the OWL and the SQUIRREL sit on the rug wrapped in a blanket, watching and laughing. Calm, cosy, magical evening light.
